name: Japan

fees.name: Short-term single-entry visa (embassy/consulate sticker visa)
fees.validity: typically 3 months to enter; stays up to 90 days
fees.applies: all visa-required nationalities (reciprocity reductions/exemptions exist for some)
fees.notes: Fee raised from JPY 3,000 to JPY 15,000 for applications filed on or after 1 July 2026 (first revision since 1978, cabinet-approved 19 June 2026). Payable in local currency at the embassy/consulate on issuance; collected only if the visa is granted. MOFA pages are Akamai-blocked to bots, so amounts cross-confirmed via consulate announcements (Consulate-General of Japan in Detroit, 'VISA FEES Effective July 1, 2026') and immigration-law firm alerts (Fragomen, Newland Chase).

fees.name: Short-term multiple-entry visa
fees.notes: Raised from JPY 6,000 to JPY 30,000 effective 1 July 2026; collected on issuance.

fees.name: JAPAN eVISA (online single-entry short-term visa)
fees.validity: single entry, stays up to 90 days
fees.applies: eligible nationalities/residence jurisdictions listed on evisa.mofa.go.jp
fees.notes: MOFA eVISA FAQ Q7: the visa fee for an eVISA (single entry) is equivalent to 15,000 yen. Nationals of some countries/regions are exempt or reduced under reciprocal arrangements, set by the mission with jurisdiction over the applicant's residence.

fees.name: Short-term business visa (single or multiple entry)
fees.notes: Japan does not have a separate business-visa fee tier; short-term business visits use the same single/multiple-entry fee schedule (JPY 15,000 / JPY 30,000 from 1 July 2026).

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Abolished. Japan's fee schedule effective 1 July 2026 states the transit visa is abolished; travellers needing to leave the airport apply for a short-term stay visa instead. Previously JPY 700. This is NOT a merge into the single/double-entry fee - the category no longer exists.

reciprocity_variations.note: Visa fee waived (gratis) for Bangladeshi nationals under a bilateral arrangement - only the VFS Global service charge applies. Since 3 November 2024 all applications must be lodged through VFS Global Dhaka; the Embassy of Japan in Dhaka no longer accepts direct applications.
Reduced rate for Indian nationals under a bilateral arrangement (VFS Global, effective 1 April 2025). The online eVISA is priced separately.

items.label: Tourist, business, medical, student and long-term visas (single or multiple entry)

reciprocity_variations.note: MOFA states nationals of some countries/regions are exempt from or pay reduced visa fees under reciprocal arrangements, but the per-country schedule page (mofa.go.jp) blocks automated access; standard rate JPY 15,000/30,000 applies unless a bilateral concession exists. USA/GBR/CAN nationals are visa-exempt for short tourist/business stays, so no fee normally arises.

vfs.note: India: INR 800 (incl. taxes) per application, charged even for fee-exempt applicants; optional courier INR 550. Japan outsources visa intake to VFS Global in many countries (India, China, Philippines, UK, Russia, etc.); service fee varies by country/centre.

free_visa_notes: Japan is not Schengen. No visa on arrival and no eTA yet (the JESTA electronic travel authorisation for visa-exempt visitors is planned but not launched as of July 2026). Nationals of ~70 visa-exempt countries (USA, UK, Canada, EU, Australia, etc.) need no visa and pay no fee for short stays. Fees collected only when a visa is issued; some nationalities are fee-exempt or reduced under reciprocal arrangements (e.g., India INR 500).
